mapper.select: SELECT round."round_number" AS "roundNumber", file."id" AS "fileResourceId", file."file_id" AS "fileId", file."original_filename" AS "originalFilename", COALESCE(file."detected_mime_type", file."declared_mime_type") AS "mimeType", file."file_size" AS "fileSize", file."width" AS "width", file."height" AS "height", file."kind" AS "kind", file."status" AS "status", relation."output_kind" AS "outputKind", relation."output_status" AS "outputStatus", relation."source_turn_number" AS "sourceTurnNumber", relation."output_order" AS "outputOrder" FROM "conversation_round_generated_file" relation INNER JOIN "conversation_round" round ON round."id" = relation."round_id" INNER JOIN "file_resource" file ON file."id" = relation."file_resource_id" WHERE round."conversation_id" = #{conversationId} AND round."deleted" = FALSE ORDER BY round."round_number", relation."output_order"

SELECT round."round_number" AS "roundNumber", file."id" AS "fileResourceId", file."file_id" AS "fileId", file."original_filename" AS "originalFilename", COALESCE(file."detected_mime_type", file."declared_mime_type") AS "mimeType", file."file_size" AS "fileSize", file."width" AS "width", file."height" AS "height", file."kind" AS "kind", file."status" AS "status", relation."output_kind" AS "outputKind", relation."output_status" AS "outputStatus", relation."source_turn_number" AS "sourceTurnNumber", relation."output_order" AS "outputOrder" FROM "conversation_round_generated_file" relation INNER JOIN "conversation_round" round ON round."id" = relation."round_id" INNER JOIN "file_resource" file ON file."id" = relation."file_resource_id" WHERE round."conversation_id" = #{conversationId} AND round."round_number" <= #{endRoundNumber} AND round."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND round."deleted" = FALSE AND file."deleted" = FALSE ORDER BY round."round_number", relation."output_order"
